title: Import one_bed_apartment Infinigen scene into SpearSim
objective: Run the documented Infinigen-to-SpearSim workflow for /home/yashturkar/Workspace/infinigen/outputs/one_bed_apartment, using a tmux session the user can attach to and targeting /Game/SPEAR/Scenes/one_bed_apartment.
instructions: Do not generate a new Infinigen scene; input already exists at /home/yashturkar/Workspace/infinigen/outputs/one_bed_apartment/coarse.
Start a detached tmux session named spear_one_bed_apartment_import and run the workflow there so the user can attach with: tmux attach -t spear_one_bed_apartment_import.
Use direct Python executables instead of relying on conda shell activation: /home/yashturkar/miniconda3/envs/infinigen/bin/python and /home/yashturkar/miniconda3/envs/spear-env/bin/python.

Export FBX from /home/yashturkar/Workspace/infinigen/outputs/one_bed_apartment/coarse to /home/yashturkar/Workspace/infinigen/outputs/spear_export_one_bed_apartment with -f fbx -r 1024. If that fails, retry once with -r 512.

Import the FBX with examples/flashlight/setup_infinigen_indoors.py using --mesh-dir /Game/SPEAR/Scenes/one_bed_apartment/Meshes and --map-path /Game/SPEAR/Scenes/one_bed_apartment/Maps/one_bed_apartment. Use --replace-existing-assets and --replace-existing-map for intentional reruns of this target.
Cook the imported map with tools/run_uat.py --cook-maps /Game/SPEAR/Scenes/one_bed_apartment/Maps/one_bed_apartment -cook -stage -package -archive -pak -skipbuild.
Log clear step headers in the tmux session and keep the session open at the end with the final status and suggested run command.
After starting the tmux session, report the session name, attach command, target map path, and whether the tmux command is running.
constraints: Do not perform Git commits, pushes, branch changes, or source code edits.
Only mutate generated/exported Infinigen outputs and SpearSim Unreal content/build artifacts required by the import/cook workflow.
expected_outputs: tmux session name and attach command.
Whether workflow was started successfully or why it could not be started.
definition_of_done: A tmux session is running or has completed the documented export/import/cook workflow for one_bed_apartment.
No Git commit or source code edit is made.
